text:
Harper Lin: planning note: single-launch newsletter for the inference benchmark + 2-step microdrip for inbound signups. want to route trial users differently from cold leads.
Diego Morales: agree. propose: trials -> tailored CTA (Try the config) + metric snapshot; leads -> Register for webinar / Read post.
Asha Kapoor: segmentation: tag by customer_status=trial OR lead_source=benchmark_post. export two lists: trials.csv and leads.csv. Riley, can ops confirm tagging webhook?
Riley Fox: will add tag bench_route=trial|lead via webhook. example payload: ```lead_id={{id}}, bench_route=trial``` Will also set a retry policy.
Harper Lin: send cadence: announcement send (global) Thurs 10am PT; trial cohort gets immediate personalized send; non-trial leads get 48hr microdrip: email2 -> case highlight + replay CTA.
Diego Morales: creative needs: short hero (25 chars), 90-char preheader, dynamic CTA for trial vs lead. I'll draft copy by Wed noon.
Asha Kapoor: deliverability ops: run seed list, throttle EU at lower concurrency, suppress active_customers. schedule seed run 24h prior.
campaign-bot: Reminder: Assets due 2025-06-10T23:59:00Z.
Riley Fox: canary plan: 5% for first 8 minutes. pause if bounce_rate>0.8%. Also timezone split: US Thu 10am PT, EU Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am SGT.
Harper Lin: analytics: track cohort-level: trial->try-conversion, lead->register. Diego, can you own dashboard?
Diego Morales: yes. will include subject variant breakdown and trial conversion funnel. will post link once ready.
Asha Kapoor: final owners: Diego (copy+analytics), Riley (ops/webhooks), Harper (launch lead). Delivery checklist in shared drive: segments, assets, ESP schedule.
Harper Lin: one-liner hero draft: "Benchmark: inference at scale". preheader: "Live demo + results: latency, throughput, cost". feedback?
Diego Morales: looks good. I'll A/B test a product-focused hero for trial cohort.
Harper Lin: great — wrapping. drop any blockers here and well do a final QA 2 hours before send. :rocket:
